stories.h: Netanyahu presses US for short new Iran air campaign
stories.s: Trump is reportedly weighing another Iran offensive as Netanyahu urges a joint four-to-seven-day strike campaign, citing chemical-weapons intelligence that some US officials doubt.

stories.h: Jewish driver wounds eight in Kafr Qasim car rammings
stories.s: A driver hit residents at four spots in the Arab city of Kafr Qasim on Wednesday evening, wounding eight, three moderately. Police arrested a Jewish suspect; residents blamed anti-Arab political rhetoric.

stories.h: Mosque near Afula torched, sprayed with pro-settler graffiti
stories.s: Masked attackers set fire to a mosque in the Galilee village of Dahi overnight, causing light damage. Police are investigating it as arson, with Shin Bet reportedly involved.

stories.h: Eisenkot camp rules out backing Liberman for premier
stories.s: Eisenkot's aides told Avigdor Liberman that Yashar would not support him for prime minister if coalition efforts fail, amid suspicions he is stalling talks. Eisenkot is seeking a minority government.

stories.h: Haredi protesters block IDF bus after draft evader arrest
stories.s: Ultra-Orthodox protesters stopped a military bus in Jerusalem for nearly an hour after police arrested a draft evader, who was sentenced to 20 days in military prison.

coming.h: Bank of Israel interest rate decision
coming.s: The Monetary Committee announces its next rate decision; the benchmark rate has been held at 3.25% since September.

coming.h: Attorney general appears before Netanyahu trial judges
coming.s: Attorney General Gali Baharav-Miara is due before the Jerusalem District Court panel to discuss how Netanyahu's corruption trial is run, after a one-week postponement.
